theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 18 群

items.colloc: take a course in 參加...課程 | enroll in a course 報名課程
items.distinct: take a class 上課 | attend a seminar 參加研討會
ex: I plan to take a course in data analysis next month.
我計畫下個月參加資料分析課程。
Many employees take a course to improve their professional skills.
許多員工透過修習課程來提升專業技能。
You should take a course before starting the certification exam.
在參加認證考試前，你應該先修習相關課程。

items.colloc: take a matter seriously 認真看待某事 | take a threat seriously 嚴肅看待威脅
items.distinct: consider carefully 謹慎考慮 | treat with respect 尊重對待
ex: Management takes these safety regulations very seriously.
管理層非常認真看待這些安全規範。
Please take the feedback from our clients seriously.
請認真看待來自客戶的回饋意見。
We must take the budget deficit issue seriously this quarter.
我們本季必須認真看待預算赤字問題。

items.colloc: take a tour of 參觀... | take a guided tour 參加導覽
items.distinct: visit 拜訪 | sightseeing 觀光
ex: We will take a tour of the new manufacturing facility.
我們將會參觀新的製造設施。
The client wants to take a tour of our headquarters.
客戶想要參觀我們的總部。
Feel free to take a tour around the office building.
請隨意參觀這棟辦公大樓。

items.colloc: take after one's father 長得像父親 | take after a parent 像父母親
items.distinct: resemble 看起來像 | look like 看起來像
ex: He really takes after his father in his management style.
他的管理風格真的很像他父親。
Does the new employee take after any of the executives?
新員工長得有像哪位高階主管嗎？
She takes after her mother in terms of her artistic talent.
她在藝術天分上很像她的母親。

items.colloc: take an examination in 參加...考試 | pass an examination 通過考試
items.distinct: sit for an exam 應試 | take a test 參加測驗
ex: All applicants must take an examination before the interview.
所有申請人面試前都必須參加考試。
I need to take an examination to obtain the license.
我需要參加考試以取得執照。
The company requires staff to take an examination periodically.
公司要求員工定期參加測驗。

items.colloc: take an order for 接下...的訂單 | be ready to take an order 準備接單
items.distinct: place an order 下訂單 | process an order 處理訂單
ex: The waiter is coming to take an order from your table.
服務生正要過來為你們這桌點餐。
Our sales team is busy taking an order from the overseas client.
我們的銷售團隊正忙著處理海外客戶的訂單。
Can you take an order for twenty units of this model?
你可以接下這款機型二十台的訂單嗎？

items.colloc: take down notes 記下重點 | take down a structure 拆除結構
items.distinct: write down 寫下 | dismantle 拆解
ex: Please take down the main points during the meeting.
開會時請記下討論重點。
The construction crew will take down the temporary office.
施工人員將會拆除臨時辦公室。
Did you take down the contact information for the vendor?
你有記下供應商的聯絡資訊嗎？

items.colloc: take notes during a lecture 上課做筆記 | take notes on a topic 針對主題做紀錄
items.distinct: keep records 保存紀錄 | jot down 隨手記下
ex: It is helpful to take notes during the training session.
在培訓期間做筆記很有幫助。
She likes to take notes on her tablet computer.
她喜歡在平板電腦上做筆記。
Make sure to take notes on the new product specifications.
務必針對新產品規格做筆記。

items.colloc: take out a loan from a bank 向銀行貸款 | take out a business loan 申請商業貸款
items.distinct: apply for a loan 申請貸款 | borrow money 借錢
ex: The small business decided to take out a loan for expansion.
這家小企業決定貸款以進行擴張。
You need good credit to take out a loan today.
你現在需要良好的信用才能申請貸款。
We had to take out a loan to purchase the new machinery.
為了購買新機器，我們不得不貸款。

items.colloc: take steps to do something 採取措施做某事 | take necessary steps 採取必要步驟
items.distinct: take action 採取行動 | implement measures 實施措施
ex: We must take steps to improve our customer service quality.
我們必須採取行動來提升客戶服務品質。
The management team will take steps to reduce operational costs.
管理團隊將採取步驟以降低營運成本。
Have you taken steps to resolve the technical issue yet?
你已經採取行動解決這個技術問題了嗎？

items.colloc: take the place of someone 代替某人 | take the place of something 取代某物
items.distinct: replace 取代 | substitute for 替代
ex: This new software will take the place of the old system.
這套新軟體將會取代舊系統。
She will take the place of the manager during his absence.
經理不在時，她將會代理其職務。
Nothing can take the place of hard work for achieving success.
沒有什麼能取代努力工作來獲得成功。

items.colloc: take turns doing something 輪流做某事 | take turns at the task 輪流執行任務
items.distinct: alternate 交替 | rotate 輪替
ex: We should take turns presenting our reports to the team.
我們應該輪流向團隊報告我們的簡報。
The staff take turns working on the weekends.
員工們輪流在週末上班。
Let us take turns to speak during the brainstorming session.
讓我們在腦力激盪會議中輪流發言。

items.colloc: think over the proposal 仔細考慮提議 | think over the offer 考慮出價
items.distinct: consider 考慮 | deliberate 斟酌
ex: Please think over the contract terms before signing it.
請在簽約前仔細考慮合約條款。
I need some time to think over the job offer.
我需要一些時間仔細考慮這份工作邀約。
Think over the strategy carefully before we present it.
在我們展示策略之前，請先仔細考慮一下。

items.colloc: to be honest with you, ... 老實說，... | to be honest with you, I think... 老實說，我覺得...
items.distinct: frankly speaking 坦白說 | honestly 誠實地
ex: To be honest with you, the project is behind schedule.
老實說，這個專案進度落後了。
To be honest with you, I am not sure about this plan.
老實說，我不確定這個計畫是否可行。
To be honest with you, we need a better marketing strategy.
老實說，我們需要一個更好的行銷策略。

items.colloc: to start with, ... 首先，... | for a start 作為開始
items.distinct: firstly 第一 | initially 最初
ex: To start with, let us review the quarterly sales results.
首先，讓我們檢視本季的銷售成績。
There were only three employees to start with.
一開始只有三名員工。
To start with, you should verify the data accuracy.
首先，你應該先核對資料的正確性。

items.colloc: top of the line equipment 頂級設備 | top of the line product 頂級產品
items.distinct: first-class 一流的 | state-of-the-art 最先進的
ex: The company purchased top of the line computers for the staff.
公司為員工購買了頂級電腦。
These are top of the line products in the electronics industry.
這些是電子產業中的頂級產品。
Our facility features top of the line manufacturing technology.
我們的工廠擁有頂級的製造技術。

items.colloc: touch up a photograph for a client 為客戶修飾照片 | touch up a digital photo 修飾數位照片
items.distinct: edit a photo 編輯照片 | photoshop 修圖
ex: Could you please touch up a photograph for the website?
你可以幫忙修飾一下網站用的照片嗎？
The graphic designer needs to touch up a photograph of the product.
平面設計師需要修飾產品照片。
It is easy to touch up a photograph using this app.
使用這個應用程式修飾照片很容易。

items.colloc: stuck in a traffic jam 卡在塞車中 | cause a traffic jam 造成交通堵塞
items.distinct: heavy traffic 車流量大 | congestion 擁擠
ex: I am running late because of a major traffic jam.
因為嚴重的塞車，我快遲到了。
There is a traffic jam on the main highway this morning.
今天早上主要高速公路發生了塞車。
Avoid the downtown area to escape the afternoon traffic jam.
避開市中心以躲避下午的塞車潮。

items.colloc: make travel arrangements 安排行程 | confirm travel arrangements 確認行程
items.distinct: itinerary 行程表 | travel plan 旅行計畫
ex: The secretary is busy making travel arrangements for the CEO.
秘書正忙著為執行長安排出差事宜。
Please send me your travel arrangements by Friday afternoon.
請在週五下午前將你的出差安排寄給我。
All travel arrangements have been confirmed for the conference.
會議的所有出差安排都已確認。

items.colloc: try on a suit 試穿西裝 | try on a new pair of shoes 試穿新鞋
items.distinct: try out 試用 | test 測試
ex: Feel free to try on the uniform before you buy it.
購買制服前請隨意試穿。
The customer wants to try on the new safety gear.
客戶想要試穿新的安全裝備。
You should try on the glasses to see if they fit.
你應該試戴眼鏡看看是否合適。
